sub_sector.value: Wafer fabrication equipment; advanced packaging equipment; wafer manufacturing tools

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures individual production tools for wet cleaning, electroplating, stress-free polishing, deposition, track and thermal processing.

production_model.detail: Customizes wafer fabrication equipment and process technology to meet customers’ processing requirements.

product_complexity.detail: Proprietary megasonic cleaning precisely controls energy distribution and bubble cavitation to protect delicate wafer features.

production_role.detail: Develops, manufactures, sells and services integrated semiconductor production tools.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves integrated circuit and compound semiconductor manufacturing, wafer-level and panel-level packaging, and wafer manufacturing and reclaim.

notes: The make-to-order classification is inferred from equipment customization.
